structure: Both call QueryInterface into a null-initialized pointer slot. The CSharp result builder and SLG runtime_preamble require nonnegative status AND nonnull pointer. Only the SLG runtime helper adds a second, conflicting failure policy.
branches: Success/nonnull retains an owned reference. Success/null and negative status are Err. The helper additionally branches to Release on a rejected nonnull pointer and rewrites success/null status.
logic: Preserve raw HRESULT and raw pointer through the runtime helper. The existing result wrapper alone selects Ok versus Err; only accepted success produces an owned interface. Rejected output conveys no owned reference and must not be released.
diagnostics: CSharp actual three cases passed. Current Native passes the valid control, rewrites zero to E_POINTER on success/null, and reduces references from1 to0 then-1 on a negative-status borrowed output. No compile diagnostic change.
